name: PayTrace

google.heading: PayTrace on Google
google.summary: No rating is published here, deliberately. PayTrace has a Spokane Valley listing carrying 13 reviews, and two things make that number unusable. The listing shows a different company's website in its details, which suggests it has been merged or mislabelled at some point. And the written reviews on it are not from merchants. They are from cardholders who paid a business that used PayTrace, saw the name on a statement or a receipt, and reviewed it: one reporting a charge they did not recognise, one complaining that their information was shared with several companies. That is a common fate for a gateway sitting behind other people's checkouts, and it says nothing about what PayTrace is like to process on. If you are evaluating it for Level 3 or B2B card processing, this listing is not evidence in either direction, and the review platforms aimed at software buyers are a better place to look.
